implementation.task_semantics: Repository task schema version 2 binds synthetic purpose, operation, effects, role, reviewer, capability references and the H-M0-028.v2 claim.
implementation.authoritative_state: scheduler-state.json resolves task, claim, dependency, project and STOP inputs; callers can submit only task_id and attempt.
implementation.safety_head: Exact project and complete STOP inventory hashes are checked on every preflight; one OPEN STOP-M0-001 and LOCKED live state are required.
implementation.identity: Only the configured checkout, canonical origin remote, and history reachable from origin/main pass; copied checkouts deny while a symlink to this checkout resolves to the same local identity.
implementation.capabilities: Every referenced capability must be uniquely repository-resolved, schema-valid, reviewed, trusted, approved, non-revoked, non-executable, credential-free and network-free.
implementation.completion: Completion and review transitions are unavailable and fail closed pending authenticated append-only evidence FUTURE_GATE.
implementation.execution: Dispatch is preflight-only and returns MOCK_ONLY; no adapter or invocation exists.

validation.historical_v1_probe_disposition: Preserved byte-for-byte and intentionally no longer green against the replaced caller-controlled API: 15 methods, 12 failed attack-success assertions, 2 errored route assertions, 1 passed denial control.

limitations: Local checkout and Git remote checks do not establish external or hostile-host trust.
No authenticated append-only evidence, completion authority, independent reviewer identity, transactional scheduler store, executor boundary, or model/usage policy exists.
STOP-M0-001 remains OPEN; M0 remains blocked and M1 remains unreleased.
